biggest_catch: The $500 tier requires depositing $25,000 within 30 days and maintaining a $25,000 balance for the rest of the 90-day qualification period; the $300 tier needs $1,000+ in direct deposits within 90 days. Availability is limited to OH, IN, KY, NC, SC, TN.
catches: Two tiers of the same promo: $300 for VIP Checking with $1,000+ in direct deposits within 90 days of opening; $500 for VIP All-Access Checking with $1,000+ in direct deposits within 90 days PLUS a $25,000+ deposit within 30 days and a maintained $25,000+ balance for the remainder of the 90 days.
New qualifying personal checking customers only — current customers who have a Park personal checking account are ineligible.
The promotion code must be entered at account opening (one-time use); the bonus will not apply if the code is missing or entered incorrectly.
Requirements are confirmed 90 days after account opening and the bonus is deposited within 15 days after that — plan on waiting roughly 105 days.
Account must not be closed or restricted at payout; limit one bonus per customer.
Bonus is considered income and may be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Offer availability subject to change at any time, and without notice.

VIP Checking has a $10 monthly fee (waived with $500+ qualifying direct deposits, $1,000+ average balance, or age 24 and under); VIP All-Access has a $25 monthly fee (waived with $25,000+ on deposit with Park).

steps: Open a new qualifying Park National Bank personal checking account (VIP Checking for the $300 tier; VIP All-Access Checking for the $500 tier) online or in branch, entering the promotion code at account opening.
For the $300 tier: receive direct deposits totaling $1,000 or more within 90 days of opening.
For the $500 tier: receive direct deposits totaling $1,000 or more within 90 days AND deposit $25,000+ within 30 days of opening AND maintain a $25,000+ balance for the remainder of the 90 days.
Keep the account open, in good standing, and unrestricted; the bonus is deposited within 15 days after the 90-day qualification confirmation.
